; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; Remove duplicates from a 1D array. ; ; :Categories: ; ; SST pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; Mats Löfdahl, Institute for Solar Physics ; ; ; :Returns: ; ; A sorted list where all elements are unique. ; ; :Params: ; ; arr : in, type=array ; ; The input 1D array. ; ; :Params: ; ; count : out, optional, type=integer ; ; The number of selected elements. ; ; indx : out, optional, type=array ; ; The indices of the selected elements. ; ; :History: ; ; 2024-12-18 : MGL. First version. ; ; 2025-05-16 : MGL. New keyword count. ; ;- function red_uniquify, arr, count = count, indx = indx indx = uniq(arr, sort(arr)) count = n_elements(indx) return, arr[indx] end ;; Usage: a = [2,1,3,2,5,1,0,4,0] print, a print, red_uniquify(a) print b = ['cat', 'gnu' , 'dog', 'ape', 'dog', 'dog', 'cat' ] c = ['domestic', 'wild', 'domestic', 'wild', 'domestic', 'domestic', 'domestic'] print, b print, c print, red_uniquify(b, indx = indx) print, c[indx] end
